links.comparator_used: Cosine-similarity vector retrieval over text embeddings (PubMedBERT, MedCPT, BGE-large-en-v1.5), including with an exact variant-ID guardrail
links.outcome: Wrong-variant retrieval for clinically distinct cancer variant pairs
links.effect: Cosine retrieval put the wrong paired variant in the top 5 for 75% to 100% of queries under the biomedical encoders (52-document corpus). The typed-graph pipeline gave a 0% wrong-variant retrieval rate with 95.8% normalization accuracy.
links.tradeoff: Depends on a normalization layer that resolves variant strings to canonical nodes (95.8% normalization accuracy, so some strings were not resolved correctly). Evaluated on only 9 variant pairs.
links.quote: Adding an exact variant-ID guardrail to cosine retrieval, and routing retrieval through an end-to-end typed-graph pipeline, both reduced wrong-variant retrieval to zero.

design_hint: exact-ID guardrails and typed-graph retrieval grounding
